data.one_liner: Pure Dart implementation of the RFC 3492 Punycode specification for encoding and decoding.
data.what_it_does: Provides encoding and decoding of Punycode strings, as well as helpers for Internationalized Domain Names (IDN) and email addresses. It supports mixed-case annotation and standard IDNA validation rules.
use_when: You need to convert internationalized domain names or emails to and from ASCII/Punycode.
You are working with Punycode encoding in a pure Dart or cross-platform application.
avoid_when: You are not dealing with internationalized domains, emails, or raw Punycode strings.
strengths: Full RFC 3492 compliance with official errata fixes
Supports mixed-case annotation via Appendix A
weaknesses: Niche functionality limited specifically to Punycode and IDNA tasks
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:punycoder/punycoder.dart';

final encoded = punycode.encode('münchen'); // mnchen-3ya
final decoded = punycode.decode('mnchen-3ya'); // münchen

final domainAscii = domainToAscii('mañana.com'); // xn--maana-pta.com
